required_points.point: Myopia means distant objects are not focused clearly on the retina
The eye’s far point is finite and the uncorrected image forms before the retina
The lens makes parallel rays appear to come from the far point so the eye focuses them on the retina

optional_points.point: For far point D, the correcting lens has f = −D for an object at infinity
